activation.title: Activate PROSM Time
activation.subtitle: Enter your activation code to set up your organization.
activation.logoHint: Optional — it will appear next to your organization's data in the Header, and on your license certificate. You can also add this later.
activation.emailPolicyNotice: The email address you use to create this organization is the only email PROSM Time will recognize for it. All technical support for this organization is provided through that email address only.

certificate.title: License Activation Certificate
certificate.footer: This certificate confirms activation of PROSM Time for the organization above.

activation.demoTitle: Try PROSM Time free for 30 days
activation.demoSubtitle: Create your organisation and its administrator now - no activation code needed. The trial lasts 30 days; your data is kept afterwards, and a purchased activation code continues it.
activation.demoNotice: Demo version: no activation code needed. The trial ends 30 days after it starts (server time). A week before, the owner is emailed; after it ends the organisation pauses with all its data kept until an activation code is entered or the license is renewed.

free.name: Free / Starter
free.description: Core clock in/out, camera evidence, basic GPS validation, basic timesheet/reporting limits.

professional.name: Professional
professional.description: Geofencing, presence sessions, exception workflow, notifications, richer reports, monthly evidence pack.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: Advanced multi-site controls, API/webhooks, advanced governance, larger operational limits, SOS/Safety Roll Call, anomaly detection.

welcome.title: Welcome to PROSM Time
welcome.subtitle: Workforce attendance, presence and time management.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to your PROSM Time organization.

acceptInvitation.title: Accept your invitation
acceptInvitation.subtitle: Enter the email and verification code your administrator gave you, and choose your password.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a code to reset your password.
forgotPassword.genericError: Unable to request a password reset.
forgotPassword.successMessage: If an account exists for this email, a password reset code has been sent.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter the email, the code we sent you, and your new password.

trial.dataKept: The app is paused and all your data is kept - nothing has been deleted. It continues exactly where you left it as soon as the license is activated.
trial.activateError: This activation code could not be used.
trial.askOwner: Ask your organisation owner to enter an activation code or renew the license.
trial.contactIntro: To buy an activation code or renew the license (license {{license}}), contact us:
trial.stillEnded: The license has not been renewed yet.
